headline: Home Furnishing Consignment
sub: Home Furnishing Consignment is the Philadelphia Main Line’s premier fine furniture consignment store specializing in preowned custom and name brand furniture. We have been in business since 1999 and have over 6500.
offerings: Come meet our experienced and friendly staff, browse our extensive inventory, and find some amazing deals!
Consign With Us! It’s the smart and easy way to sell! We take care of everything from pricing, merchandising, marketing, as well as third.
Conveniently located on the Mainline in Wayne, in the bustling Gateway Shopping Center, we’re closer than you think.
